# Irish Laundry Systems

> Engineering-led commercial laundry specialist serving the Republic of Ireland since 1987. Irish Laundry Systems supplies, installs, rents, maintains and repairs commercial laundry equipment, and is an Authorised Electrolux Professional Partner. Based in Dublin (D.S.B. Electrical (Templeogue) Limited). Registered Electrical Contractor and Registered Gas Installer. Phone +353 1 491 0402, email contact@irishlaundrysystems.com.

## Services

- [Preventive Maintenance](https://irishlaundrysystems.com/preventive-maintenance): Scheduled servicing, preferential call-out support, reporting and aftercare to reduce breakdown risk and downtime.
- [Repairs & Call-Outs](https://irishlaundrysystems.com/repairs-call-outs): Engineer-led breakdown repairs and call-outs across Ireland, genuine parts, clear communication.
- [Equipment Rental](https://irishlaundrysystems.com/equipment-rental): Lower-upfront-cost equipment for replacement or expansion, with installation and maintenance included under the rental agreement.
- [Support & Aftercare](https://irishlaundrysystems.com/support-aftercare): Ongoing advice after installation or repair — servicing, parts and future equipment needs.
